fact: This document is the text of Lei n.º 34/2014 of 31 December 2014, the Lei do Direito à Informação, passed by the Assembleia da República to set the legal mechanisms for exercising the right to information; it applies to State bodies, direct and indirect administration, local authorities and private entities doing public-interest work or using public resources.
system: Lei n.º 34/2014, Lei do Direito à Informação (2014)

fact: Carta de Moçambique reports that Mozambique's Law 34/2014 on the Right to Information, passed by Parliament on 26 November 2014, is being implemented, per the Ombudsman's annual report to the Assembly.
system: Lei do Direito à Informação (Lei nº 34/2014)

fact: The Ombudsman's annual report says public bodies received 60,433 information requests in 2024, of which 57,998 were granted (95%), 1,589 denied and 846 pending.
